```sql
WITH
-- 2023 data
centre_2023 AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre" AS centre,
        "Month",
        ("Avg Daily Present"::FLOAT / NULLIF("Enrolled Kids"::FLOAT, 0)) * 100 AS monthly_attendance_percentage
    FROM "attendance_2023"
    WHERE "Centre" IN (
        'Chembur Balwadi', 'Dharavi Balwadi', 'Govandi Balwadi',
        'Kurla Balwadi', 'Mankhurd Balwadi', 'Sion Balwadi',
        'Wadala Balwadi', 'Worli Balwadi'
    )
),

-- 2024 data
centre_2024 AS (
    SELECT
        "centre_name" AS centre,
        "month",
        ("average_attendance"::FLOAT / NULLIF("enrolment"::FLOAT, 0)) * 100 AS monthly_attendance_percentage
    FROM "attendance_2024"
    WHERE "centre_name" IN (
        'Chembur Balwadi', 'Dharavi Balwadi', 'Govandi Balwadi',
        'Kurla Balwadi', 'Mankhurd Balwadi', 'Sion Balwadi',
        'Wadala Balwadi', 'Worli Balwadi'
    )
),

-- Combined monthly averages
monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT
        centre,
        AVG(monthly_attendance_percentage) AS avg_monthly_attendance_percentage
    FROM centre_2023
    GROUP BY centre
),

monthly_avg_2024 AS (
    SELECT
        centre,
        AVG(monthly_attendance_percentage) AS avg_monthly_attendance_percentage
    FROM centre_2024
    GROUP BY centre
)

-- Final side-by-side comparison
SELECT
    COALESCE(ma2023.centre, ma2024.centre) AS centre,
    ma2023.avg_monthly_attendance_percentage AS "2023 Average Attendance (%)",
    ma2024.avg_monthly_attendance_percentage AS "2024 Average Attendance (%)"
FROM monthly_avg_2023 ma2023
FULL OUTER JOIN monthly_avg_2024 ma2024 ON ma2023.centre = ma2024.centre
ORDER BY centre;
```
